issues.description: In-app payment processing simulates gateway operations without encryption or standard PCI-DSS compliance integration.
issues.suggestion: Integrate external trusted payment provider (e.g., Stripe, PayPal SDK) rather than accepting raw credit card numbers and CVV.

issues.description: Floating point arithmetic used for financial calculations (basePrice * TAX_RATE). Can lead to precision rounding errors in monetary charges.
issues.suggestion: Store monetary amounts in integer cents (e.g. 999 instead of 9.99) and round deterministically.

issues.description: Hardcoded console.error for payment failure instead of structured logging with telemetry.
issues.suggestion: Use structured logger and record audit events for compliance.

codeQuality.summary: Contains critical revenue and payment processing logic. Direct credit card handling requires PCI-DSS compliance or third-party tokenization. Financial calculations should avoid floating-point math.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Core financial payment pipeline is completely untested. Failures could cause uncollected revenue or unwarranted upgrades.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("successfully processes valid payment and upgrades subscription", async () => { const success = await processPremiumPayment("user-1", validPayment, "premium"); expect(success).toBe(true); const sub = await getUserSubscription("user-1"); expect(sub?.tier).toBe("premium"); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Card validation logic for card length, CVV length, and expiration date has zero automated tests.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("rejects expired cards and malformed CVV", () => { expect(validatePaymentDetails({ ...validPayment, expiryDate: "01/20" })).toBe(false); expect(validatePaymentDetails({ ...validPayment, cvv: "12" })).toBe(false); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Subscription access control protects premium capabilities and needs validation for expired vs active subscriptions.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("denies access when subscription is expired", async () => { const hasAccess = await hasFeatureAccess("expired-user", "unlimited_todos"); expect(hasAccess).toBe(false); });

untestedPaths.reasoning: Tier pricing calculation including tax and processing fees must be verified to prevent undercharging.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("calculates correct amount for premium and enterprise tiers", () => { expect(calculateSubscriptionPrice("premium")).toBeCloseTo(11.08, 2); });

testCoverage.summary: Complete absence of test coverage (0%) for critical payment, pricing, and subscription authorization logic.

suggestions.description: Extract payment gateway interaction into an injectable PaymentProvider strategy interface.
suggestions.before: async function chargeCard(payment: PaymentDetails, amount: number): Promise<boolean> { ... }
suggestions.benefits: Allows mocking in unit tests, swapping gateways (e.g. Stripe), and decoupling business logic from payment transport.

suggestions.description: Refactor monetary amounts to integer cents to prevent IEEE 754 precision issues.
suggestions.benefits: Safe integer calculations prevent floating point currency discrepancies.

refactorings.summary: Decouple payment processor via dependency injection and adopt integer cents for accurate financial pricing.

recommendations.description: BLOCK MERGE: Write comprehensive test suite covering processPremiumPayment, card validation, and subscription authorization before deploying payment code to production.
Replace raw credit card handling with tokenized payment provider (PCI-DSS compliance).
Extract PaymentProvider interface to support dependency injection and unit test mocks.
